title: Raycast header
description: A floating rounded bar fixed to the top: a hairline ring and a faint top-left sheen over a blurred dark fill. A wordmark at the left, nine grey links centred (white on hover), a quiet 'Log in' and the light keycap button at the right on desktop; a wordmark and a menu icon opening a dropdown panel on phones.
notes: fixed to the top: the page needs no top padding, the hero leaves room
